svg.title: Angenent-torus translator end: quotient and slice
svg.desc: The numerical Angenent meridian swept with square-root height growth in the rotation quotient, beside its torus slice at relative height four. Copper marks the selected quotient loop through the surface. The auxiliary model sets the unknown translator correction to zero; no compact core or translator PDE solution is shown.

g.text: Leading model (√z x, z) • numerical Angenent profile • u = 0
to recover a torus in ℝ³.
Open rims truncate one end. The compact core is not drawn.
